performance_issues.recommendation: Consider caching parsed label templates in memory since they rarely change

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache parsed label template results in memory

resource_load.note: Multiple git config reads + gpg process execution

performance_issues.description: Every request executes git config commands and gpg --export process
performance_issues.recommendation: Cache the exported GPG key since signing keys change very rarely

performance_issues.description: gpg --export is called with timeout=-1 (no timeout)
performance_issues.impact: If gpg hangs, the request will hang indefinitely
performance_issues.recommendation: Set a reasonable timeout (e.g., 10 seconds) for gpg execution

optimization_recommendations.description: Add timeout to gpg process execution
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevent request hangs when gpg is unresponsive
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Change -1 timeout to 10*time.Second in ExecDir call

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache GPG public key export result
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Eliminate process spawn on every request
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Cache result with TTL or invalidate on signing key config change
